notes:
v1.6.0 - Bribe bargaining
New: the bribe system now supports real negotiation. When a merchant offers a bribe, the Sheriff can counter with a higher demand instead of an immediate pass/inspect, and the merchant can accept, reject, or counter again. Each negotiation allows up to 3 counter-offers, after which only accept/reject (or pass/inspect) remain.
New: AI players (easy/normal/hard) negotiate too - sheriffs squeeze suspicious merchants for more gold, and merchants weigh the value of their smuggled goods before accepting, rejecting, or bargaining back.

v1.5.3 - Bug fixes
Fix: bots no longer freeze when you host a room - a missing argument in the AI decision code crashed the server bot thread, so bots never acted (regression from v1.5.0).
Fix: the home screen "What's New" panel showed English text with square boxes - update notes now follow the UI language and no longer render carriage-return characters.
Fix: the home screen avatar bar was squished with overlapping text - avatar preview layout reworked.

v1.5.2 - UI polish and home-screen redesign
Mods list and Mod Market are now scrollable, so many mods are fully visible.
Home screen redesigned: grouped Settings / Avatar / Tools cards, fixed paste & avatar-path input positions, scrollable "What's New" panel shows the latest update notes.
Lobby: new scrollable panel lists installed gameplay-rule mods with descriptions and categories.
Room settings renamed "Rounds" to "Turns" (it is the number of turns, not rounds).
"Leave Room" now returns to the main menu instead of quitting the game.

v1.5.1 - Fixed: "Update & Restart" did nothing (from v1.4)
Fix: an interrupted update used to leave a pending flag in %TEMP%\SheriffUpdate; after that every click silently "succeeded" without installing. The flag now records the batch process id and is auto-cleared when stale, so updates always re-run.
Fix: the background update script now writes update.log / inno_install.log and, if the silent install still fails, opens the GitHub releases page as a fallback.
Improvement: the installer now defaults to a per-user folder, so silent auto-updates never need an admin elevation prompt.
GUI: home screen grouped panels, lobby sections, update changelog panel, 6 new rule mods + mod compatibility checks, bot personalities (from v1.5.0).

v1.5.3 - 缺陷修复
修复：自己开房后人机不再行动 - AI 决策代码缺少一个参数，导致服务器人机线程崩溃、人机全程卡死（v1.5.0 引入的回归）。
修复：首页“最新更新”全是英文与方框 - 更新说明现在跟随界面语言显示中文，并去除回车字符导致的方框。
修复：首页头像栏缩在一起、文字重叠 - 重新调整头像预览布局。

v1.5.2 - 界面优化与首页改版
模组管理与模组市场现在支持滚动，模组再多也全部可见。
首页改版：游戏设置 / 头像 / 工具三栏卡片布局，修复粘贴按钮与头像路径输入框位置，底部新增可滚动的“最新更新”面板展示更新内容。
房间页新增可滚动的“玩法模组”栏，展示已启用规则模组的名称、说明与分类。
房间设置中“轮数”更名为“回合数”（实际是回合数）。
“退出房间”现在返回主菜单，不再直接退出游戏。

v1.5.1 - 修复：更新并重启无效（自 v1.4 起）
修复：中断的更新会残留 %TEMP%\SheriffUpdate 标记，之后每次点击都会静默“成功”却不安装。现在标记会记录批处理进程 ID，过期自动清除，更新始终会重新执行。
修复：后台更新脚本现在写入 update.log / inno_install.log，若静默安装仍失败，会打开 GitHub Releases 页面作为兜底。
改进：安装程序默认安装到当前用户目录，静默自动更新不再需要管理员权限弹窗。
界面：首页分组面板、房间页分区、更新页更新日志、6 个新规则模组与模组兼容性检查、AI 人格（来自 v1.5.0）。
